title_o: Head up, foot down: Object words orient attention to the objects' typical location.
verdict_reason: The trial-level .sav (osf.io/nk74v; 1320 trials, 22 subjects) holds RT, accuracy and typicality; the within-subject ANOVA on error rate reproduces F(1,21)=1.45, p=.242, eta_p^2=.065, the table's numbers; the report states both the RT and the error-rate tests.

data_files.notes: Subj, Trial, conditio, item, RT, Correct (string "True "/"False"), resp_corr (factor), typisch

key_test.test: one-way repeated-measures ANOVA, typisch (typical vs atypical location), on per-subject error rate; the table records the error-rate effect (RT effect: F=0.001, p=.97)

recompute.method: base R recomputation (aov with Error(S/T) on subject x typicality means; ez not installed)

obstacles: script runs two tests (RT and error rate); only the p-value match says the table uses error rate
script's as.numeric(data$Correct) yields NA under current read.spss (Correct is a string); resp_corr must be used
script reports generalized eta^2 (.033) while the table's .065 is partial eta^2
script's RT exclusion keeps incorrect trials, unlike the report (no effect on the error-rate test)
